ruleDefinitions.name: Potential Command Line Path Traversal Evasion Attempt
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects potential evasion or obfuscation attempts using bogus path traversal via the commandline

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX(".*\\\\Windows\\\\.*") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\\\\.\\\.\\\\Windows\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\\\\.\\\.\\\\System32\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\\\\.\\\.\\\\\\\.\\\.\\\\.*"))) OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.exe\\\\\\\.\\\.\\\\.*")) AND  NOT (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Google\\\\Drive\\\\googledrivesync\\\.exe\\\\\\\.\\\.\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Citrix\\\\Virtual\\ Smart\\ Card\\\\Citrix\\\.Authentication\\\.VirtualSmartcard\\\.Launcher\\\.exe\\\\\\\.\\\.\\\\.*"))
